name: models::model_options

test_list.description: The [nebius.effort] map low..max becomes model options in that order; a model used by several efforts (high and xhigh in the defaults) appears once.
The default option index points at the model configured for effort high.
Label is the id after its last '/', or the whole id when it has none.
A config layer that overrides nebius.effort.max replaces that model in the list (the GUI never adds names of its own).

inputs.name: effort
inputs.description: Effort to model map from the loaded configuration.

output_description: Model options for the composer menu and the index of the default (high effort) model.
